expectations.text: States the AICPA issued an exposure draft on October 28, 2026 (draft dated October 27, 2026): the Proposed 2027 SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and Description Criteria, the first major refresh since the 2017 TSC
expectations.evidence: Response hedges: "I cannot confirm that a new set of Trust Services Criteria has been finalized" and never states the October 28, 2026 exposure draft or its title.
No comment deadline stated; only generic advice to "Check the AICPA ASEC site for any exposure drafts, the comment deadline".

expectations.text: States the proposed effective date: engagements beginning on or after December 31, 2027, with early adoption permitted
expectations.evidence: No proposed effective date given; discusses only historical transition periods (e.g., 2018).

expectations.text: States current engagements are unaffected: the 2017 TSC with 2022 revised points of focus remain operative
expectations.evidence: The operative criteria are still the 2017 Trust Services Criteria (TSP Section 100), with revised points of focus issued in 2022.

expectations.text: Describes the direction accurately: keeps the five trust services categories, consolidates overlapping criteria, adds AI-related points of focus without new AI-specific criteria, and does not assert specific criteria counts as fact
expectations.evidence: Does not describe the proposal's direction at all (explicitly declines to); it avoids inventing facts but never states the consolidation, retained categories, or AI points of focus.
